_comment: General dictation corpus for the ASR benchmark. Freshly authored, Parleq-appropriate dictation-shaped utterances. Each entry: id, text (== reference transcript fed to the TTS generator), category. WER scoring normalizes numbers/punctuation via the Whisper text normalizer, so references are written naturally.
